acceptanceCriteria: Recognizably belongs to the Void Horrors family and preserves every identity invariant.
Reads specifically as Outer Sovereign, T5, rather than another family form.
Communicates the Unresolved-Ring Sovereign (Sovereign) archetype and its battlefield duty.
Preserves coherent load-bearing anatomy, complete limbs, and believable ground contact.
Uses at least two fire construction dimensions without a palette-only or glow-only treatment.
Keeps the attack telegraph and counterplay signal visible at gameplay scale.
Frames one complete featured subject with no crop, labels, UI text, or watermark.
Output remains a candidate until independent approved-review evidence exists; it is never a runtime asset.
anatomyInvariants: Silhouette-shaped absence ringed with unblinking eyes and geometry that remains deliberately unresolved.

Signature mechanic: Arena Phase — Unfinishable Witness: one eye-ring interval opens, the world-shaped absence subtracts a quadrant, and a lower Void Horror performs its learned rule along the last resolvable boundary.
battlefieldDuty: Phase an arena around an unresolved sovereign absence whose eye ring restages each learned subtraction rule.
constructionDimensions: Material/structure branches: T1 faceless thin limbs, missing edge, and no reflection gain one external ember bracket; T2 the face-hole rim gains a ceramic heat gate; T3 the eye orbit and star interior gain cooling brackets; T4 the partial contour and negative limb gain bounded heat markers; T5 the eye-ring and unresolved absence gain one external ignition interval.

Motion/process branches: T1 the thin-limb missing edge opens one external combustion cycle without filling the absence; T2 the face-hole rim exhausts through its heat gate; T3 eye orbit pauses cool the star-interior brackets; T4 the partial negative limb redirects smoke between markers; T5 the unresolved eye-ring ignites and cools one interval.
counterplay: Answer the called lower-form subtraction and strike the open eye-ring interval; each closed group restores a boundary and removes one phase route. Affinity signal: Affinity counterplay branches: T1 the faceless thin-limb missing edge with no reflection opens its external cooling bracket after combustion; T2 the face-hole rim exposes the heat-gate vent after exhaust; T3 the eye orbit and star interior expose a cooling gap between cycles; T4 the partial negative limb exposes the bounded cooling marker after smoke redirects; T5 the unresolved eye-ring exposes its ignition interval between cycles.
identityInvariants: Rough humanoid or many-limbed absence retains edges that fail to close while proportions shift only within readable tier silhouettes.
Matte void black, negative space, purple-black, star flecks, and one bounded cold eye accent remain source grammar rather than affinity evidence.
Absence, non-reflection, star-field interior, fractured geometry, eye rings, and geometric shards never resolve into ordinary flesh or matter.
Power subtracts coherence: later forms occupy less resolvable physical presence while telegraph anchors become deliberately sparse.
telegraph: A group of unblinking eyes closes in sequence while geometry refuses to resolve around the remaining open interval.
